title: Pole replacement with crane - Ferntree Gully Road, Scoresby
location: Ferntree Gully Road, Scoresby VIC (pole SCB 2214)
summary: A well-run briefing: HV isolated under an access permit, crane near live LV with a spotter and covers, traffic barriers and wind limits. Fills many hazards with evidence; the supervisor reviews the remaining typical-hazard gaps.

lines.speaker: u-crew-1
lines.text: Morning all. This is the pole replacement on Ferntree Gully Road, Scoresby, pole SCB 2214. Work order 5530917.

lines.speaker: u-crew-1
lines.text: We're swapping the rotten pole for a new concrete one. The eleven kV goes on the new crossarm and there's LV underbuilt.

lines.speaker: u-crew-2
lines.text: The HV is isolated and earthed under access permit AP 7731. The LV is still alive, so we treat it as live.

lines.speaker: u-crew-4
lines.text: Crane's a forty tonne Franna, outriggers fully extended on the mats. Closest the boom gets to the LV is about three metres.

lines.speaker: u-crew-2
lines.text: I'll be the dedicated spotter on the boom the whole time, and we'll put insulating covers on the LV.

lines.speaker: u-crew-1
lines.text: Suspended load. Nobody under the pole while it's on the hook, and we use tag lines to steer it.

lines.speaker: u-crew-4
lines.text: Ferntree Gully Road is a sixty zone and busy, so we've got a traffic management plan, a lane closure with water barriers and a traffic controller on each end.

lines.speaker: u-crew-2
lines.text: Dial before you dig is done for the new hole and we potholed yesterday, nothing in line with the auger.

lines.speaker: u-crew-1
lines.text: Wind's picking up around midday. If it's gusting over thirty k's we stop the lift.

lines.speaker: u-crew-4
lines.text: Who's grabbing coffee? I'll have a flat white.

lines.speaker: u-crew-1
lines.text: Emergency. Muster point is the bus stop on the north side of Ferntree Gully Road. Nearest hospital is the Angliss in Upper Ferntree Gully.

lines.speaker: u-crew-4
lines.text: I'm the first aider, kit's in my ute. Comms is UHF channel eighteen between us and the crane.
